text: The figures show a strong financial position with revenue of 267,021 million, a 27.1% EBITDA margin, PAT of 49,454 million, ROE of 46.1% and a very low debt‑to‑equity ratio of 0.11, confirming the “almost debt‑free” narrative. However, the working‑capital cycle has lengthened from 80 to 93 days, indicating a potential weakness despite the overall solid performance.
